text:
Alex Carter: Heads up — finance just flagged ~1.2M in GPU spend this quarter with missing cost_center tags. Need to map ownership before we consider any new Reserved commitments.
Maria Chen: Where's the spend concentrated? region / project? :eyes: 
Alex Carter: Mostly eu-west1 and ap-southeast1. Billing export shows a lot of compute/VM and GKE node costs with empty label sets. I ran a quick top-50.
Alex Carter: Query I used (BigQuery):
```
SELECT resource.name AS resource_name, labels.key AS label_key, labels.value AS label_value, ROUND(cost,2) AS cost
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp.billing_export_v1`
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(labels) AS labels
WHERE DATE(usage_start_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND service.description LIKE '%Compute Engine%'
AND (labels.key IS NULL OR labels.key NOT IN ('cost_center','owner','env'))
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Jamal Singh: That matches what I saw — several ephemeral pools created by sandbox infra tooling that never set tags. Also some old nodepools created by terraform before label enforcement.
Liz Park: Any chance the RBAC/admission webhook we rolled out missed a region? We enabled the pod/node labeling webhook in us-west2 only last month.
Maria Chen: Good call — webhook config shows allowedRegions = ["us-west2","us-east1"], so eu-west1 and ap-southeast1 are unprotected. That's why we have drift.
Noah Patel: Finance: can we get a CSV mapping of the top untagged resources grouped by product team? We need to chargeback Q1 before closing books.
Alex Carter: I'll export a CSV from that BQ query and include project/resource IDs.
Jamal Singh: Proposed remediation plan: 1) Backfill tags for existing resources where ownership is clear via CSV join to internal ledger. 2) Run a script to annotate GKE nodepools / GCE instances for ambiguous cases and create tickets for manual review. 3) Enforce tagging via webhook for eu-west1 and ap-southeast1. 4) Re-run billing attribution and update cost center chargebacks.
Maria Chen: I'll own step 1 (CSV + join with internal ledger) — ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jamal Singh: I'll draft the backfill script (gcloud + kubectl) and a careful dry-run. Example commands for the backfill:
```
# annotate GKE node pool
gcloud container node-pools update NODEPOOL_NAME --cluster CLUSTER --region eu-west1 --update-labels=cost_center=ml-research
# add labels to GCE instance
gcloud compute instances add-labels INSTANCE --labels=cost_center=ml-research --zone=eu-west1-b
```
Liz Park: I'll extend the webhook config to include eu-west1 and ap-southeast1 and add a monitoring alert for "untagged GPU allocation" — target rollout Thu night.
Noah Patel: Finance Bot: created ticket FIN-4129 to accept the interim chargeback based on the CSV; final adjustment after backfill. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Billing Bot: auto-note: billing export snapshot saved to gs://redwood-billing/snapshots/1783459876.csv
Alex Carter: Quick utilization snapshot to inform commitments: last 30 days = ~420 GPU-months consumed across clusters. Current reserved commitments = 300 GPU-months (mostly us-west2/us-east1). Effective utilization of reserved capacity ~70%. If we backfill and shift workloads we could raise effective utilization to ~85% in eu regions.
Maria Chen: So decision point for reserved commitments: delay adding new commitments until after backfill and utilization re-run. If backfill yields >80% utilization, we consider moving 50 GPU-months to eu-west1 commit for lower unit cost.
Jamal Singh: I'll prepare a utilization forecast script that extrapolates 30/60/90 day usage and models commitment ROI curves. Will post results by Friday.
Liz Park: Short-term guardrails: please block any new GPU nodepool creation in eu-west1/ap-southeast1 without `cost_center` and `owner` labels — I will push a policy.
Alex Carter: Action items summary: 
- Maria: CSV join with ledger + CSV posted to #eng-infra (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Jamal: Backfill dry-run script + utilization forecast (ETA Fri)
- Liz: Webhook + policy rollout for eu-west1/ap-southeast1 (ETA Thu night)
- Noah/Finance: Hold new commitments until we re-evaluate post-backfill (Finance ticket FIN-4129)
Alex Carter: If anyone objects to the plan or has alternate data, flag now. Otherwise we'll proceed and update the exec summary for next week's infra review. :thinking_face:
Noah Patel: OK from finance — hold new commit approvals until Jamal's ROI numbers.
Maria Chen: Uploading CSV to the thread now.
Alex Carter: Thanks — appreciate the quick sync. (reaction :thumbsup:)
